reviews.comment: This was supposed to be a regular class but then on the first day she put it online and we had to learn everything ourselves with recorded videos. During the actual optional class she would answer questions, but it wasn't helpful. We had to do the labs on our own too. The class would have been easy if she had actually showed up to teach.

She made this a flipped classroom so we never HAD to attend class as long as we watched the lectures at home & didn't have questions. The labs were long, but if you set a time to do them every week it becomes really  easy to get through this class. I never had a problem and that's because I never let myself fall behind in lecture and lab.

The only thing this class composed of was five easy group assignments and one end-of-semester group project that was also fairly easy. It took my group less than four hours to get it done in one setting. Watching her lectures was not necessary at all. This class was so laid back I forgot I was taking it half of the time. Nevertheless, I loved it.
reviews.ratingTags: Group projects--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Dr. Thompson made this class so easy to understand! If you have taken GEOG 232 before this class then the quizzes should be a breeze. My only complaint is that the labs are extremely long and tedious, but she can't really help that. I would totally take her again if I had the chance!

When I meet someone that is considering taking a class with Dr. Thompson, I always tell them to sign up ASAP! This is one of the many classes I have taken with Dr. Thompson and I wish I could take more. She is the most dedicated professor I have ever met and she will go above and beyond to help you understand concepts and content.

I really loved the GEOG 619 class taught by Dr. Thompson. You can tell she is really dedicated to helping students learn and succeed, and she puts a great deal of effort into her lectures. I was able to learn a lot about GIS and she always gave really great feedback on every assignment and project. She was also super accessible outside of class!

One of the easiest classes I've ever taken. Professor keeps lectures interesting and cares about students doing well. Group projects were a bit annoying but overall you can't go wrong with this class.

Watch the lectures and take good notes. This will definitely help on the test as they are open note/open Google, and no Honor Lock. However, she will not provide a study guide. The group projects can get overwhelming considering it is an online class, however, the professor and TA are extremely understanding and it is manageable. Would take again.
Dr. Thompson is very sweet. Her tests are clear and her communication is good. There are a couple of group projects that are a little challenging but they are doable.

It seems sill to complain about an easy A+, but it was almost insulting it was so pointless. Everything is open notes, tons of extra credit. Isn't this supposed to be college? The only thing missing was nap time.

I took this course during the summer while also taking another course and working 30+ hours a week. It was very do-able. Her lectures and notes are great, no need for the textbook. Exams open note, very easy. Several group assignments but not too bad. Take her if you can!

Dr. Thompson is an amazing professor who is very kind and knowledgeable. She's very understanding of the student experience during the pandemic and helps put grad school into perspective. Seminar was student facilitated and led so what we wanted to discuss was valued and supported. Def recommend her for any class she teaches!

The content is interesting and Prof Thompson is really cool and understanding! The tests were open note, open book, open google... so there was really no need to study if you pay attention in class. She records all her lectures. There are a couple group projects but they weren't bad. This was my easiest class this semester. Highly recommend!!

Professor Thompson is an amazing person and is an even greater professor. Her lectures are engaging and informative. She is very understanding and helps you if you have any problems. I would definitely recommend taking her.

A true gem of a professor. You can clearly tell she has mastery in her field but she is so kind. She understands things get rough, especially during a pandemic, and is super accommodating. She makes intimidating material easier and does not make any student feel lesser when they ask to repeat things. I truly wish she could teach all of my classes.

This professor is so personable and everyone in the class loved her. She is a great teacher and makes the material fun, and is super understanding of students. Ive never had a professor that is so understanding and respectful of students, and would highly recommend taking this class.

This has been my favorite class thus far at Texas A&M, partly because Dr. Thompson is an awesome prof. Labs are time consuming but the material is not too difficult, and there are tons of resources offered if you're struggling. Put in the work for the labs and study for the exams and a good grade in the class is very achievable.

Courtney is amazing. From the beginning, she told us Principles of GIS was a tough class but she was such a patient and good lecturer that it wasn't necessarily tough (my lab TA a whole other story though...). She gives out a lot of extra credit opportunity and lets you bring a cheat sheet to the test. she also brings candy!! super funny and nice.

I went into GEOG 201 just looking to get it out of the way for an ICD credit. Turns out, Prof. Thompson was by far the best prof I've ever had. Her lectures were very intriguing and she has a great sense of humor. She allowed notes for the test, so as long as you take good notes (or get them somehow), you'll walk out with an easy A+

One of the best profs I've ever had. Super funny (she makes her lectures super entertaining by inserting memes throughout the power points). Took her for GEOG 360, or Natural Hazards, and she was AMAZING. This semester was her first time teaching this course, but she did a phenomenal job.

took her for natural hazards-great great professor! Totally recommend taking this class not only for an easy science credit but also to get a good laugh with her meme use. Had the class mondays and wednesdays- and mon were lecture while wed was group in class assignments- super easy course

Professor Thompson is so nice and super laid back. You only have to attend 10 classes to get full attendance credit and an in class exercise maybe once a week. Other than that, only 3 tests and a group project. She posts lectures online and gives you a full page cheat sheet for exams. Offers a bunch of extra credit. I loved her class- an easy A!

She has days before the 3 total exams (incl. final) where she reviews the pwpts. and explicitly tells you what will be on the exam. Copy that down onto your one sided typed "cheat-sheet" and bring that to the exam. The 5 person group project was also easy and required a 5ish page paper to be typed (easy if everyone carries their weight).

I loved her class! It was the easiest and most fun class I've taken in my first semester of college. She is a very easy grader. Came out with a 99 in the class. If you need an easy GPA boost, this is the class for you.

I LOVED this class. Super easy, you get a page of notes to use on the exams, and there is no final. Dr. Thompson is so sweet and hilarious and I loved going to the lectures. You have to go to class because once a week there are group assignments but they are not hard at all. Easy A, you shouldn't have to worry about this class.

Take this class if you have an open spot in your schedule, easily the best class to take for ICD at TAMU. Mrs. Thompson is super chill and gives a lot of extra credit so there's not much to stress about. Group projects once a week, couldn't rate this class any better.

A great professor to take that sparked my interest in human geography. Passionate about the subject and for her students. Three exams, group exercises, and a group project have made it an absolute easy A -- especially when they're open-note. Extra credit is always out there as well, but don't depend on it for a high letter grade.

Thompson is amazing. Her lectures are interesting and she uses quality memes. She really cares about the subject and her students. Most of the grade came from in class exercises and exams were not bad at all. If given the chance, definitely take her!

Taking this class probably the best decision I made during registration. Dr. Thompson is fantastic and clearly cares about this subject and her students' success. The assignments were mostly in class group projects, pretty simple overall. The tests were not bad at all, and she allowed us to have a page of notes so there's no way to do poorly.

She was absolutely amazing. My class had Tuesday lectures with a break halfway in and she always kept it interesting. Thursdays we "group assignments", which was basically a completion grade. We had one group assignment at the end which was not even bad. During activities Thursdays she would come around and make sure we understand the material.

I took this class because it looked interesting, and seemed like fun. Overall I love the class, it is fun and she does a good job of explaining. If you just look over the powerpoints before the tests you'll be fine. There is next to no outside of class time needed to get a good grade, but you'll still understand a lot of useful information!

Courtney made the class easy to understand and enjoy. Tests are for the most part pretty forward. She allows for extra credit and is not a tough grader. Better to attend class because activities are 50% of your grade. Overall one of the better profs at this university so if you can take her, take her.

AWESOME prof! Take her! 1/2 lecture, 1/2 super easy activities. Very funny, quirky, and caring. Loved going to class. No HW, nothing cumulative. Go to the review the class before the test. No reading. Posts lecture slides online. Some maps in book are on tests, but are usually in the slides. Easy A! Uses memes! Good for science credit!

Dr. Thompson is an AMAZING professor. She is very caring and provides multiple ways to get extra credit in the class. The lecture grade is 50% of the total grade stemming from three tests and one small in class assignment. The other 50% stems from the lab portion of this class, which even she admits is frustrating.
Explains things super well and is always ready to help outside of class. She's super friendly and gives tons of extra credit.
reviews.ratingTags: ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Clear grading criteria--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Courtney is an excellent professor. She makes a pretty tough subject understandable. One of the best qualities about her is she has a lot of experience with what she teaches, so you know you're getting the info straight from the source. Tests are fair, and there isn't really homework or quizzes. She loves memes!
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Dr. Thompson may be one of my favorite professors Ive ever taken. She was often easily available/reachable outside office hours and every lecture has a minimum of 2 or 3 memes. She genuinely cares too. She saw we were all worried before our first exam and decided to skip the days lecfure and instead have a review! Absolutely would take her again.
